title: Deep re-audit for another 100,000 eliminable lines
evidence_quality: 1 of 7 programs PROVEN; the remaining 6 INFERRED. The eliminable pool is small enough that the inferred/proven split does not change the conclusion.

hypotheses_refuted.hypothesis: crates/hawking-core carries four model families each duplicating the same forward pass, so one generic architecture plus per-family constants would free tens of thousands of lines.
hypotheses_refuted.evidence: Pairwise family similarity measured at jaccard < 0.11. qwen_dense, deepseek_v2, rwkv7 and llama are architecturally distinct, not copies. Only ~800 lines of thin shared helpers are extractable.
hypotheses_refuted.note: This was the single largest remaining reduction hypothesis in the campaign. Its refutation is what closes the arc's descent.

hypotheses_refuted.hypothesis: Twenty hide-* crates for one product implies cross-crate duplication.
hypotheses_refuted.evidence: hide-backend production code is load-bearing and the duplication is not between the crates. The crate count is product surface area, not repeated architecture.

hypotheses_refuted.hypothesis: 15,897 lines of shaders are hand-written permutations one parameterised kernel would replace.
hypotheses_refuted.evidence: Hand permutation exists but safe reclamation is under 1,000 lines without taking decode risk.

honest_verdict: 100,000 additional eliminable active LOC beyond the in-flight lanes is not present. The measured pool is ~14,200. After the campaign-engine repair (~45k) and the Rust test compression (~13.5k) land, the honest floor sits near 480,000 with HIDE in the tree and near 376,000 with HIDE relocated -- and the campaign gives relocation zero credit. The 300,000 target is not reachable by condensation.
note_for_floor_declaration: This supplies the irreducible subsystem budget the campaign requires before any rung may be declared structurally impossible. Combined with the Track B arithmetic rejection, two materially different architectures have now failed to reach 300k.
